rules.description: React components should use a consistent style for defining components
React components should not be nested
React Context value should be memoized
React props should be read-only
React state should be updated correctly
React's "Children.only" should be used correctly
React's "useState" hook should not be called conditionally
React's "useEffect" should not return anything other than a function or undefined
React Hook dependencies should be exhaustive
Strings should not be concatenated using '+' in a loop
Deprecated React APIs should not be used
React's keys should be unique and stable
Functions should not be empty
String literals should not be duplicated
Cognitive Complexity of functions should not be too high
Credentials should not be hard-coded
Endpoints should not be vulnerable to reflected cross-site scripting (XSS) attacks
"dangerouslySetInnerHTML" should not be used
"target=_blank" should be avoided
React's iframe elements should sandbox their content
React event handlers should not be bound in JSX props
React components should use shorthand syntax
Identical JSX elements should be refactored
Unused local variables should be removed
Dead stores should be removed
Local variables should not be declared and then immediately returned or thrown
Tests should include assertions
Ternary operators should not be nested
Object literal shorthand syntax should be used
"await" should only be used with promises
Braces and parentheses should be used consistently with arrow functions
Literals should not be thrown
"undefined" should not be assigned to variables
All branches in a conditional structure should not have exactly the same implementation
"await" should not be used in loops
Collection elements should not be replaced unconditionally
Optional boolean parameters should have default value
Template strings should be used instead of concatenation
Conditions should not always evaluate to the same value
Reducers should always return a new state
React components should specify a key when rendering lists
React component props should be validated with PropTypes
React's "findDOMNode" should not be used
React's default export should be a component
React components should not be defined as arrow functions
React components should not directly modify state
React components should have a stable identity
